ui.dialog.welcome.title: Dinastro EU-Дракономор
ui.dialog.welcome.text-1: Welcome to some of the most beautiful places in World of Warcraft! Open the Places panel on the left to choose a location. Each location has several views to explore in the Views panel at the bottom.
ui.dialog.welcome.text-2: The Settings and Help buttons are in the top-right corner. In Settings, you can change the language, adjust the music volume, and turn interface sounds on or off. Select Help to show these tips again.
ui.dialog.welcome.text-3: Press Space while viewing a location to pause or resume the music. Clicking or tapping the app resumes playback.
